t: This is the Royal Court Theatre, on Sloane Square. A theatre has stood here since 1870, though the building you see was completed in 1888. It has about 380 seats today, and it is non-commercial, which means it exists to stage work rather than to turn a profit. Since 1956 it has been home to the English Stage Company, which focuses on contemporary theatre. The architects Bertie Crewe and Walter Emden, both leading theatre designers of the great building boom between 1885 and 1915, are credited with its design.
